name: Indomitable Pointcap
description: Hold a poised crouch with the blade ready at the shoulder as a pair of hawks wait on a ledge.

name: Verity Stabtip
description: Mark the opponent from two sides of the body at once and choose the weaker line to dive on.

name: Pokeglimmer
description: Take two quick steps from different angles so the opponent cannot tell which one will carry the stab.

name: Lacerating Sting
description: Prick high with the point and low with the pommel in one motion so the guard cannot cover both.

name: Rumble Handguard
description: Beat the opponent's blade from two sides in quick succession to break his grip and his rhythm.

name: Gust Cutedge
description: Turn a counter-cut aside with the edge and bound back out of its reach in the same movement.

name: Nickwrath
description: Strike from above and from the flank in one sweeping dive that gives the guard no safe parry.

name: Vanishing Dig
description: Break from the dive and return to the starting crouch beyond reach ready to stoop again.

name: Eviscerating Gore Scourge
description: Dive on a feint from one side and land a single qi-dense stab from the other through the guard.

name: Aegis Hiltcap
description: Sink the guard low and wide like a basin so cuts fall into it and lose their edge.

name: Mangling Cutedge
description: Slide the inner edge along the opponent's blade to cut the wrist of the hand holding it.

name: Torrent Poke
description: Give ground in a short pooling step that draws the opponent onto the prepared point.

name: Vigilant Broadleaf
description: Read how heavily the opponent commits his weight and qi so the basin may take the right amount.

name: Thumbmettle
description: Catch the cut in the hollow of the blade and turn it slowly aside while absorbing its first shock.

name: Ponderous Hiltcap
description: Press down on the opponent's blade with a heavy steady weight that leaves his arm slow and tired.

name: Corroding Stab
description: Return the opponent's gathered force through a stab along the inner edge to his open ribs.

name: Glamour Handguard
description: Let a heavy cut fill the guard to the brim and spill its whole force back as a single counter.

name: Adamantine Shortspine
description: Hold a dense steady guard that no single blow can break and every blow deepens.

name: Hollowgore
description: Overturn the whole guard in a single thrust that carries the opponent's own pressure through the point.

name: Unbowed Stubblade
description: Stand with qi flowing along both arms and the blade in the middle where the two streams will meet.

name: Stingruin
description: Stab with the left-side qi stream leading and the right in reserve to follow the thrust.

name: Murk Knobgrip
description: Parry with the right-side qi stream while the left rests ready to attack.

name: Headlong Cutedge
description: Step along the edge of the opponent's reach as along a riverbank and enter where it narrows.

name: Thumbinsight
description: Feel where the opponent's streams of qi divide and which side is the weaker flow.

name: Iron Sting
description: Drive both streams down the blade to meet at the point and prick through a narrow gap.

name: Webbing Thumbrest
description: Cross the blade over the opponent's like a sandbar crossing a stream and hold it fast.

name: Booming Nick
description: Flick the point sideways in the direction the second stream is running to cut an unprepared arm.

name: Gorewrath
description: Bring both streams together at the instant of contact for a thrust of doubled force.

name: Impervious Pointcap
description: Let two streams guard the body in turn so one is always ready while the other recovers.

name: Titanic Nova Sting
description: Gather both rivers of qi into a single full release at the point that bursts through guard and armor.

name: Flintlike Handguard
description: Set the feet on two separate tracks wide enough to turn but narrow enough to close.

name: Digwrath
description: Stab by body force alone along the first track while qi waits on the second.

name: Inexorable Cutedge
description: Parry by qi alone along the second track while the body holds its position.

name: Tipblink
description: Slide the feet in short paces along the inner track toward the opponent's centre.

name: Punishing Poke
description: Swap the lead track mid-cut so the stab arrives from the side the opponent did not guard.

name: Numbing Knobgrip
description: Beat the blade on one track while the point comes in on the other to confuse the guard.

name: Glint Gore
description: Pierce along the inside track past the guard arm before the opponent has recovered.

name: Obdurate Broadleaf
description: Hold body and qi in a shield on both tracks so that no single parry can pass them.

name: Overlapping Nick
description: Weave a stab and a step and a beat along alternating tracks so each hides the next.

name: Stubscourge
description: Drive body and qi along parallel tracks and join them at the point to impale through a guard.

name: Dazzling Stabtip
description: Break out of a bind by shifting both body and qi to the track the opponent is not pressing.

name: Ironstab
description: Converge both tracks into a single point of force inside the guard and release it in one stab.

name: Unrelenting Knobgrip
description: Stand utterly still with the blade low and the breath hushed so that the opponent forgets the point.

name: Nickflash
description: Advance in the blind line behind the opponent's eye with each step falling with his own.

name: Ferocious Gore
description: Reach with a fully extended arm and stab the hand holding the opponent's weapon.

name: Murk Thumbrest
description: Touch aside a cut with a very light motion that wastes none of the blade's strength.

name: Waning Hiltcap
description: Feel the opponent's balance as a hawk feels the air beneath it and strike when it fails.

name: Gnashing Stabtip
description: Show the point only at the last moment and stab with qi into the exposed ribs.

name: Glamour Nick
description: Draw the opponent's gaze to an empty hand and let the blade come from below.

name: Hogtying Cutedge
description: Enter without a sound and press the blade flat to the opponent's weapon before he moves.

name: Pokehavoc
description: Drift beneath the opponent's guard on a low line and cut the tendons behind the knee.

name: Decimating Stab
description: Strike from stillness in one sudden dive through the guard with full qi behind the point.

name: Stubglare
description: Withdraw into the quiet stance after the strike so that the opponent cannot find the point again.

name: Overbearing Shortspine
description: Spread a silent pressure about the opponent that dulls his reflexes while the blade circles close.

name: Pitiless Poke Reckoning
description: End the exchange in a single silent stab placed before the opponent has understood it began.

name: Adamantine Hiltcap
description: Open with a measured salute of the blade that sets distance and holds a perfect guard.

name: Thumbruin
description: Take exactly one pace and thrust at exactly arm and blade length from the guard.

name: Prescient Pointcap
description: Judge the gap between the bodies to a finger's width before committing to any step.

name: Equipoise Stabtip
description: Wait until a cut is fully committed and then turn it aside with the smallest possible motion.

name: Overpowering Dig
description: Hold a steady point on the line that forbids the opponent from advancing.

name: Glint Poke
description: Answer the opponent's opening move with a stab timed to the moment his blade leaves the guard.

name: Gust Stab
description: Step in or out by the precise distance that leaves the opponent's cut a finger short.

name: Ruinous Dig
description: Impale the opponent in a single stab placed exactly as the formal rules of the court demand.

name: Unconquered Thumbrest
description: Hold a guard without flaw where no cut finds any gap while the opponent exhausts his strength.

name: Regal Sting
description: Deliver the single perfect thrust the whole canon prepares for with qi gathered into the exact point.

name: Evergreen Stubblade
description: Hold the guard between two banks of force with the blade where the streams are about to join.

name: Digscourge
description: Thrust at the fork where the opponent's two lines of defense divide.

name: Stabvortex
description: Cross from one line of attack to the other in a single flowing step.

name: Torrent Broadleaf
description: Guide a cut away on a side channel so it joins the main flow harmlessly.

name: Remnant Cutedge
description: Sense the point where the opponent's two streams of force are about to meet.

name: Vengeful Gore
description: Prick with both edges working as one along the join of two overlapping defenses.

name: Immobilizing Handguard
description: Turn the opponent's blade into a backwater where it circles and cannot leave.

name: Rampaging Sting
description: Rush forward with a swelling rain of stabs like a river in flood that no guard can hold.

name: Nickruin
description: Merge two pulses of force at the point and drive them through the opponent's guard together.

name: Unbudging Knobgrip
description: Spread the guard like a delta so that a cut loses its force across many channels.

name: Pokeflash
description: Flash across the gap along the meeting of two currents and land a stab before the eye has registered the move.

name: Impenetrable Cutedge
description: Hold twin guards at the limit of the mortal frame with the blade at the line where they meet.

name: Vessel Nick
description: Drive the body to its limit in a single thrust that uses every muscle in one line.

name: Digvortex
description: Take a step as fast as the mortal body allows and hold the blade level on arrival.

name: Shattering Stubblade
description: Send qi through the whole meridian network into the edge for one clean powerful cut.

name: Meridian Pointcap
description: Hold two lines of guard from a full network of meridians to meet any cut with ready force.

name: Overbearing Dig
description: Press down with a double tide of qi that slows the opponent's blade and his breathing alike.

name: Meridian Sting
description: Pierce with the whole network behind the point at the peak of mortal power.

name: Ghosting Hiltcap
description: Retire from the stab in two matched steps and return to the twin guard without a gap.

name: Nickscourge
description: Cut with both edges of the twin guard in a single stroke that spends every reserve of the mortal frame.

name: Obdurate Hiltcap
description: Stand square to the plateau wind with the knees bent and the blade low and quiet.

name: Stubhavoc
description: Thrust with the wind at the back so the point carries the full push of the air.

name: Gust Thumbrest
description: Lean forward into the wind and take a long gliding step on the strength of the gust.

name: Unerring Handguard
description: Check the wind's direction against the opponent's stance before choosing the line of approach.

name: Gust Broadleaf
description: Beat a cut aside in the instant a gust rises and add the wind's push to the parry.

name: Lacerating Cutedge
description: Let the wind lay a thin line of pressure along the short edge for a deeper and faster cut.

name: Headlong Knobgrip
description: Rush over open plateau ground at a pace the opponent's wind-blind eyes cannot track.

name: Inexorable Pointcap
description: Meet a downward cut with a rising stroke and the updraft lifts the blade clear of its edge.

name: Suffocating Stabtip
description: Hold the opponent in place under a steady wind of pressure from the sword's point.

name: Stabwrath
description: Add the whole weight of the plateau wind to the stab and impale the opponent on the point.

name: Torrential Knobgrip
description: Withdraw on a gust in a long smooth glide and land beyond the opponent's reach.

name: Rumblegore
description: Gather the plateau wind into the point and release it in a single storm-heavy stab.

name: Unassailable Shortspine
description: Stand on the sworn line and hold the blade level without shifting a foot.

name: Nickhavoc
description: Stab with the edge bound to a single line and never wavering from it once begun.

name: Vanishing Poke
description: Advance a sworn pace and then another without turning aside for any threat.

name: Flintlike Cutedge
description: Parry with an edge held to its promise so that no cut can drive it from the line.

name: Iron Gore
description: Stab with qi tied to the line like a thread that ties the point to its target.

name: Gyve Hiltcap
description: Press the opponent's blade and hold it with the full weight of a sworn purpose.

name: Invincible Stubblade
description: Hold the guard on the sworn line against any pressure until the oath is satisfied.

name: Brutalizing Gore
description: Drive the bound edge through the opponent along the sworn line with a qi-heavy stab.

name: Unconquered Cutedge
description: Hold the line after the stab and turn the counter-cut aside without shifting the point.

name: Wrathful Intent Poke
description: Complete the sworn line with a single qi-dense thrust that may not be turned from its mark.

name: Impervious Stubblade
description: Stand with the shoulders squared on the bearing and the point steady along it.

name: Tipwrath
description: Thrust along the bearing and bring the point back to it after every exchange.

name: Silt Poke
description: Step around the opponent in a circle that keeps the bearing fixed at his centre.

name: Mastering Hiltcap
description: Set the point on the bearing so firmly that the opponent cannot step across it.

name: Unsparing Stab
description: Stab on the bearing unmoved by any feint and strike the opponent's real position.

name: Stubnerve
description: Parry in a way that returns the blade exactly to the bearing for the next stab.

name: Glint Sting
description: Drive qi along the sworn bearing and impale the opponent in a single stab no feint can turn.

name: Indomitable Broadleaf
description: Hold the bearing against all pressure so no cut can cross it and reach the body.

name: Hollownick
description: Complete the bearing in a single qi-laden thrust that nothing the opponent does can turn aside.

name: Unbowed Cutedge
description: Stand in open air with no cover and the blade ready to meet any approach.

name: Digruin
description: Stab at the moment a gust fills the air so that the sound and dust cover the thrust.

name: Gust Poke
description: Slip sideways on a draught of air so the opponent's thrust meets nothing.

name: Gust Hiltcap
description: Guide a cut off along the wind's current so the blade deflects without a clash.

name: Remnant Handguard
description: Find the still pockets in the wind where the opponent will stand and strike there.

name: Hellish Dig
description: Send a thin cutting edge of wind alongside the short sword to strike two lines at once.

name: Unseen Stabtip
description: Kick up a swirl of air around the feet to hide the approach and the angle.

name: Harnessing Knobgrip
description: Bind the opponent's blade with a pressure of wind and steel that has nothing behind to give.

name: Grievous Cutedge
description: Rake the edge across the opponent's face with the gale's weight on the arm.

name: Pokeruin
description: Add a driving wind to the stab so it pierces through armor at a depth the arm cannot reach.

name: Adamantine Broadleaf
description: Raise a thin wall of whirling air about the guard that blunts the force of an incoming cut.

name: Confluent Stab
description: Burst in with a stab and a returning wind-cut so two strikes land on the same beat.

name: Stingvortex
description: Cross open air in a flash with the wind carrying both swordsman and point and land a single stab.

name: Invincible Pointcap
description: Stand loose in the wind with the blade tucked and the weight ready to cross a great distance at once.

name: Stubblink
description: Stride across a wide gap in three bounding steps and arrive with the blade forward.

name: Stubruin
description: Land the first step and stab in the same instant so no guard can be set.

name: Unrelenting Hiltcap
description: Parry from the end of a long stride with the flat of the blade held at arm's reach.

name: Chime Pointcap
description: Feel the whole gap between the two bodies in the wind and time the first stride to it.

name: Hellish Gore
description: Let the wind carry the swordsman in a long glide that ends in a prick at the throat.

name: Strangling Broadleaf
description: Close on the opponent's blade as a gust closes a door and hold it fast.

name: Blinding Dig
description: End a long stride with a short hard step that plants the body for a heavy stab.

name: Ferocious Nick
description: Cross the full gap and deliver a stab at the inner line with the wind's whole weight behind it.

name: Lightning Cutedge
description: Rebound from the strike on the returning wind and land at a safe distance with the guard up.

name: Meteoric Gore Flash
description: Cross the width of a gale in a single heartbeat and end the exchange with one stab inside reach.

name: Granite Cutedge
description: Stand as at the plateau pledge with the blade low and the weight even on both feet.

name: Berserk Stab
description: Thrust once as a pledge made good and bring the blade back to the line at once.

name: Thumbblink
description: Advance at a steady fixed pace that does not hasten or slow with the opponent's motion.

name: Unbowed Pointcap
description: Parry plainly without trick and trust in the edge to turn the cut aside.

name: Stabhavoc
description: Stab at the spot named in the pledge and hold the line until the point lands.

name: Overpowering Hiltcap
description: Press the opponent back under a steady wind that bears down on him like a watching witness.

name: Evergreen Knobgrip
description: Hold the guard through a long assault as a person holds a pledge through hardship.

name: Ruinous Stabtip
description: Drive the edge through the guard in one stab that carries the oath's weight and cannot be turned.

name: Obdurate Cutedge
description: Root the feet to the ground like a plateau and receive any charge without moving.

name: Ironnick
description: Make good the promise of the whole lesson set in one qi-heavy stab to the sworn mark.

name: Impenetrable Knobgrip
description: Hold a quiet stance for a long watch with the blade steady and the breath slow.

name: Pitiless Dig
description: Choose the single thrust the opponent has left open and make it without haste.

name: Silt Stab
description: Circle the opponent at a slow pace to wear down his guard before closing.

name: Verity Cutedge
description: Read where the opponent's weight sits and wait for it to shift beyond recall.

name: Murk Broadleaf
description: Parry without hurry at the last moment and keep the point on the bearing.

name: Immobilizing Pointcap
description: Hold the point on the opponent's centre in patience until he is forced to move into it.

name: Gnashing Dig
description: Stab along the chosen line with qi gathered patiently at the point.

name: Pokeglare
description: Enter on the opponent's committed step at the last possible instant and cut his line.

name: Strangling Stubblade
description: Hold the bearing to the very end of the exchange and let the opponent's impatience break his own guard.

name: Tipruin
description: Release a long-held bearing in a single stab of full qi and unhurried precision.

name: Unassailable Thumbrest
description: Hold the blade ready until the right moment and give the opponent no safe angle at all.

name: Gravestab
description: Deliver the one chosen stab placed so exactly that it passes the physical guard and finds the body.

name: Impervious Hiltcap
description: Stand at the summit of the mortal frame with the blade low and the wind about the arm.

name: Pokescourge
description: Drive the thrust with the whole body and a rising wind at its back.

name: Nickglimmer
description: Step on the gust at the very peak of the body's speed and set the blade level.

name: Brutalizing Cutedge
description: Pass qi through the whole network into a wind-edged cut at the very limit of mortal power.

name: Meridian Handguard
description: Hold a guard sworn to the wind with every meridian carrying its share of the load.

name: Numbing Gore
description: Press down with a tide of wind and qi that slows the opponent's cuts and clouds his judgment.

name: Vessel Gore
description: Pierce with every meridian behind the point in an oath-bound stab at mortal tier's highest reach.

name: Blinding Nick
description: Turn out of the stab on the wind and return to guard before the counter can land.

name: Guststing
description: Spend the full reserve of the mortal frame in one wind-driven cut that closes the exchange.
